symptom: The open PR matcher admits a retrospective protocol when its digest matches, admits malformed result metrics, and throws for null or a failing ambient serializer rather than returning false.
lesson: A matching digest proves only bytes, not a valid prospectively frozen protocol. A boolean admission matcher must validate both runtime records, enforce protocol-before-result chronology, and convert unexpected exceptions into false.
guardrail: Before accepting a Forward Vault result, validate both record kinds and fields, compare exact protocol/result timestamps, require matching frozen digest and metric family, and test malformed, retrospective, and ambient-serializer negative cases. Keep research/production disconnected.
